Theorem
[classification under nonnegative complex sectional curvature]

Source: petersen:page-0404 ↗ thm:pet-ch10-gallot-meyer 1. ch10:10.3.8Let $(M,g)$ be a compact Riemannian $n$-manifold with nonnegative complex sectional curvature. Then one of:

  1. $(M,g)$ is reducible or locally symmetric;

  2. $M$ is diffeomorphic to a space of constant positive curvature;

  3. the universal cover of $M$ is biholomorphic to $\mathbb {CP}^{n/2}$.
